budgets.title: Budget
budgets.intro: How much each category can spend every month. Recurring transactions count with their monthly share in every month, even when they are not due: a yearly bill of €1,200 weighs €100 a month, and its payment is not counted again.

family.title: Family balance
family.intro: How much each user has to transfer to the joint wallets, so that everyone contributes in equal measure: transfers from the personal wallets to the joint ones and shared expenses paid from the personal wallets are added up since the first month of the contribution.
family.empty: No family contribution yet: set below how much the family transfers to the joint wallets every month.

contributions.title: Family contributions
contributions.intro: How much the family transfers to the joint wallets every month, in total, from the first month on: every user contributes an equal share of it. One per currency, as amounts are never converted.
